PhysicsWallah Co-founder Discusses Q3 Profitability and Expansion Plans

PhysicsWallah co-founder Prateek Maheshwari stated the company is targeting Profit After Tax (PAT) growth in the third quarter. He also indicated that the company plans to slow down its offline expansion to concentrate on profitability. These statements were made by Maheshwari, who is a co-founder of PhysicsWallah.
